newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin works at home, not likely to visit Kremlin.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin works at home, not likely to visit Kremlin.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin will work on documents on Wednesday at the country residence where he is recovering from pneumonia and he is not expected to visit the Kremlin, the presidential press office said.
Yeltsin has already cancelled a trip to the Hague on doctors' orders but a spokesman said Sunday's meeting with French President Jacques Chirac would go ahead as scheduled.
Yeltsin, 65, visited the Kremlin on Tuesday for the second time in one week, meeting Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin and other officials.
He looked alert on brief television film of the meetings, but has clearly lost a considerable amount of weight since being taken ill, first with heart problems then with pneumonia.
It was the first television footage of the Russian president since January 6.
